I want to teach my infant basic sign language. Things like, "I want food, drink, more, done, dirty diaper, up, play, etc."

anybody else get their infant communicating before talking, any tips for this or maybe some book recommendations??

I taught both of my daughters sign back in the day. I personally feel it truly helped keep frustration down. The book I used was signing illustrated isbn 0-339-52134-8. It is a really good layout and I am using it again now.

Our neighbor also used sign with their daughter (mine were grown then). It was wonderful to be able to comunicate with her even though she could not speak yet.

I now have a new son and am just starting with him as well. I just picked up "Raising a Happy Child" on kindle. It is actually about why to teach sign and basic signs that are helpful.

I love the one story she gives about visiting her brother who owns a dog. The daughter had not been around one before. The next day, the daughter kept signing dog. Dog dog dog. The mother mentioned how wonderful it was to know what her non comunicative daughter was thinking about. Amazed to be able to realize the impact seeing a dog had on her. Without sign she would not have been able to know what was on her daughter's mind.

From being around friends who did not teach sign and seeing the difference in frustration and communication level, I will always hands down recomend sign. Children definitely have their own thoughts and opinions at a very early age, they just can't express them.
